title: Explicit etale-origin witness
statement:
An object $K\in\Dplus(T_{\Proet},\Lambda)$ *comes from the etale site* if it
is equipped with a pair

$$
 (L,\alpha),\qquad
 L\in\Dplus(T_{\Et},\Lambda),\quad
 \alpha:\nu_T^*L\xrightarrow{\sim}K,
$$

where $\nu_T^*$ is the inverse image of the comparison morphism of sites
[def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. The pair $(L,\alpha)$, rather than
only its existence, is retained when maps are transported.

lean.statement: structure FixedEtaleOriginWitness (T : Scheme.{u}) (A : Type (u + 1)) [Ring A] (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf (ProEt.topology T) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)))
lean.note: Section 1(B): the recorded EtaleOriginWitness has a continuous-function ringed-module target, and FiniteEtaleOriginWitness also has ringed-module endpoints after scalar restriction. Neither accepts the ordinary fixed-scalar D+ objects used by supportClosedDerivedPlus and FixedComparisonClassAdjunction. This module reexports that full interface unchanged and states the same retained pair (a bounded-below etale object and its specified comparison isomorphism) directly in fixed-scalar module coordinates. It permits arbitrary rings, with no added constructibility, commutativity, topology, or finiteness hypothesis. It neither chooses an antecedent from Nonempty nor replaces the pair by a property.
